title.gu: Estimating અને Costing ના મૂળભૂત ખ્યાલો

title.en: Unit 1 Notes — Fundamentals of Estimating and Costing
title.gu: યુનિટ 1 Notes — Estimating અને Costing ના મૂળભૂત ખ્યાલો

items.syllabus_item: 1.1 Meaning, purpose, administrative approval, technical sanction, budget provision

body.en:
Estimating determines probable quantities of work from drawings and specifications; costing assigns appropriate rates and project charges to assess the probable cost. An estimate supports feasibility, budgeting, approvals, tendering, procurement and cost control; it is not automatically the final expenditure or a contractor’s bid.

Administrative approval is the competent administrative authority’s in-principle acceptance of the need, scope and approximate cost. Technical sanction is the competent engineering authority’s approval of the detailed design, quantities, rates and estimate. Budget provision is allocation of funds under the appropriate head. Exact powers, sequence and validity follow the relevant department and financial rules; approval alone does not create a budget allocation or permit work without other required sanctions.
body.gu:
Estimating માં drawings અને specifications પરથી કામની સંભવિત quantities નક્કી થાય છે; costing માં યોગ્ય rates અને project charges લગાવી સંભવિત ખર્ચ ગણાય છે. Estimate feasibility, budget, approvals, tendering, procurement અને cost control માટે ઉપયોગી છે; તે આપોઆપ અંતિમ expenditure કે contractor ની bid નથી.

Administrative approval માં સક્ષમ વહીવટી અધિકારી જરૂરિયાત, scope અને અંદાજિત ખર્ચને સિદ્ધાંતતઃ સ્વીકારે છે. Technical sanction માં સક્ષમ engineering authority detailed design, quantities, rates અને estimate મંજૂર કરે છે. Budget provision એટલે યોગ્ય head હેઠળ funds ફાળવવા. સત્તા, ક્રમ અને validity સંબંધિત department તથા financial rules પ્રમાણે છે; approval માત્રથી budget allocation કે અન્ય જરૂરી sanctions વગર કામ શરૂ કરવાની મંજૂરી મળતી નથી.

items.syllabus_item: 1.2–1.4 approximate detailed revised supplementary repair maintenance renovation

body.en:
Approximate estimate is a preliminary cost forecast from limited information and comparable rates, used for feasibility and administrative decisions. Detailed estimate itemises quantities, specifications and rates from developed drawings and supports technical sanction and tendering.

Revised estimate updates an earlier sanctioned estimate when expected cost or scope changes beyond the applicable departmental tolerance; state the reasons and compare old and new amounts. Supplementary estimate covers additional necessary work not included in the original scope; its relationship to the original sanction must be stated. Repair/maintenance estimate covers work to preserve or restore serviceability; renovation estimate addresses planned alterations or upgrading. Departmental financial rules determine exact triggers; do not invent a universal percentage.
body.gu:
Approximate estimate મર્યાદિત માહિતી અને comparable rates આધારિત પ્રારંભિક ખર્ચ અંદાજ છે; feasibility અને administrative decisions માટે વપરાય છે. Detailed estimate વિકસિત drawings પરથી item-wise quantities, specifications અને rates આપે છે તથા technical sanction અને tendering માટે ઉપયોગી છે.

Revised estimate માં મંજૂર estimate પછી ખર્ચ અથવા scope સંબંધિત departmental tolerance કરતાં બદલાય ત્યારે નવી ગણતરી અને કારણ સાથે જૂની-નવી રકમની સરખામણી થાય છે. Supplementary estimate મૂળ scope બહારના જરૂરી વધારાના કામ માટે છે અને મૂળ sanction સાથેનો સંબંધ દર્શાવે છે. Repair/maintenance estimate serviceability જાળવવા કે પાછી લાવવા માટે અને renovation estimate આયોજનબદ્ધ ફેરફાર કે upgrading માટે છે. ચોક્કસ triggers departmental financial rules નક્કી કરે છે; એક જ ટકાવારી બધે માનવી નહીં.

items.syllabus_item: 1.5 service unit, plinth area, cubical content, typical bay and approximate quantity methods

body.en:
Service unit: number of beds, students, seats or similar functional units × comparable cost per unit. Plinth area: covered built-up area at floor level × current plinth-area rate for a similar specification; define inclusion of balconies and floors using the applicable rule. Cubical content: measured building volume × comparable rate per cubic metre, useful when heights differ. Typical bay: number of comparable bays × cost per typical bay, with end bays and special parts separately allowed. Approximate quantity: estimate major item quantities or wall-length quantities × suitable composite rates, then add excluded works.

Adjust historic/comparable rates for location, date, specification and market changes; identify services, foundations, site works and taxes included in the benchmark before adding allowances. State uncertainty and avoid double counting.
body.gu:
Service unit: Beds, students, seats જેવા functional units × સમાન કામનો પ્રતિ unit ખર્ચ. Plinth area: Floor level પર covered built-up area × સમાન specification નો current plinth-area rate; balconies અને floors નું inclusion લાગુ rule મુજબ સ્પષ્ટ કરો. Cubical content: Building volume × સમાન દર પ્રતિ cubic metre; height જુદી હોય ત્યારે ઉપયોગી. Typical bay: સમાન bays ની સંખ્યા × એક bay નો ખર્ચ; end bays અને special parts અલગ ઉમેરો. Approximate quantity: મુખ્ય item quantities અથવા wall-length quantities × યોગ્ય composite rates, પછી બાકીના કામ ઉમેરો.

જૂના/comparable rates ને location, date, specification અને market changes પ્રમાણે સુધારો. Benchmark માં services, foundations, site works અને taxes પહેલેથી સામેલ છે કે નહીં તે જાણી allowances ઉમેરો. Uncertainty સ્પષ્ટ કરો અને double counting ટાળો.

items.syllabus_item: 1.6 roads, railways, bridges, culverts, irrigation and water supply

body.en:
Choose a functional unit that matches the project scope. Roads and railways may be budgeted per kilometre for similar terrain, cross-section, pavement/track, earthwork and structures; bridges and culverts may use deck area, span or comparable type, with foundations and approaches separately identified. Irrigation projects may use canal length, command area or storage capacity with major structures and land cost separately stated. Water supply may use population served, capacity or length and diameter of mains; include source, treatment, reservoirs, distribution and power only once.

These are early benchmarks, not a substitute for design and site investigation. Terrain, bridge foundations, land acquisition, utilities, escalation, environmental compliance and service connections can dominate the difference between projects.
body.gu:
Project scope સાથે મેળ ખાતો functional unit પસંદ કરો. Roads અને railways માટે સમાન terrain, cross-section, pavement/track, earthwork અને structures હોય તો પ્રતિ kilometre benchmark લઈ શકાય; bridges અને culverts માટે deck area, span અથવા સમાન type અને foundations તથા approaches અલગ દર્શાવો. Irrigation projects માટે canal length, command area અથવા storage capacity અને મુખ્ય structures તથા land cost અલગ દર્શાવો. Water supply માટે population, capacity અથવા mains ની length અને diameter લઈ source, treatment, reservoirs, distribution તથા power એક જ વાર ઉમેરો.

આ પ્રારંભિક benchmarks છે, design અથવા site investigation નો વિકલ્પ નથી. Terrain, bridge foundations, land acquisition, utilities, escalation, environmental compliance અને service connections થી projects ના ખર્ચમાં મોટો તફાવત આવે છે.

h.gu: 1.5 Estimator ની જવાબદારી અને item checklist

items.syllabus_item: 1.7–1.8 roles and checklist of load bearing and framed structures

body.en:
The estimator reads coordinated drawings and specifications, inspects site constraints, lists items, identifies measurement rules, takes quantities systematically, obtains current authorised rates, checks arithmetic and omissions, prepares abstract and records assumptions. Maintain traceable revisions and communicate uncertainties; do not alter quantities to meet a predetermined budget.

Typical checklist: site clearance, excavation, disposal, foundation PCC, foundation masonry or RCC, plinth filling and damp-proof course, walls or RCC columns/beams/slabs, stairs, lintels/chajjas, roofing and waterproofing, flooring, doors/windows, plaster, finishes, plumbing, sanitation, electrical, external works and testing. In load-bearing work walls carry loads; in framed work columns and beams carry the frame loads and walls generally act as infill. Actual design and drawings control: do not count masonry where a full-thickness RCC member replaces it.
body.gu:
Estimator સંકલિત drawings અને specifications વાંચે, site constraints તપાસે, items ની યાદી અને measurement rules નક્કી કરે, પદ્ધતિસર quantities લે, current authorised rates મેળવે, arithmetic તથા omissions તપાસે અને assumptions સાથે abstract તૈયાર કરે. Revisions traceable રાખો અને uncertainty જણાવો; પૂર્વનિર્ધારિત budget મેળવવા quantities બદલવી નહીં.

સામાન્ય checklist: Site clearance, excavation, disposal, foundation PCC, foundation masonry અથવા RCC, plinth filling અને damp-proof course, walls અથવા RCC columns/beams/slabs, stairs, lintels/chajjas, roofing તથા waterproofing, flooring, doors/windows, plaster, finishes, plumbing, sanitation, electrical, external works અને testing. Load-bearing structure માં walls load વહન કરે છે; framed structure માં columns અને beams frame load વહન કરે અને walls સામાન્ય રીતે infill હોય છે. વાસ્તવિક design અને drawings મુજબ full-thickness RCC member ની જગ્યાએ masonry ફરી ન ગણો.

body.en:
Measurement sheet records item description, location, number, length, breadth, depth/height, additions and deductions, quantity and unit. Put unlike items and different specifications separately. Abstract sheet gathers each item total, unit rate and amount; sum the amounts and add authorised charges exactly once. Face sheet summarises the project, authority, basis, civil cost, applicable additions, total, dates, signatures and approval references as required by the department.

For example record excavation as 2 × 3.00 m × 0.60 m × 0.90 m = 3.24 m³, then transfer 3.24 m³ to the abstract at its rate. A face-sheet summary cannot replace detailed dimensions and the source drawing.
body.gu:
Measurement sheet માં item description, location, number, length, breadth, depth/height, additions તથા deductions, quantity અને unit નોંધાય છે. જુદા specification અને અલગ items ને અલગ રાખો. Abstract sheet માં item total, unit rate અને amount આવે છે; amounts ઉમેરી મંજૂર charges એક જ વાર ઉમેરો. Face sheet માં project, authority, basis, civil cost, લાગુ additions, total, dates, signatures અને approval references departmental format મુજબ હોય છે.

ઉદાહરણ તરીકે excavation માટે 2 × 3.00 m × 0.60 m × 0.90 m = 3.24 m³ નોંધો, પછી 3.24 m³ ને તેના rate સાથે abstract માં મૂકો. Face-sheet summary detailed dimensions અને source drawing નો વિકલ્પ નથી.

items.syllabus_item: 1.10 IS 1200 modes of measurement and desired accuracy

body.en:
Measurement depends on the item and applicable part of IS 1200: excavation, concrete and substantial masonry are commonly in m³; plaster, flooring, roofing, formwork and painting commonly in m²; pipes and certain skirting or mouldings in m; structural steel or reinforcement by mass (kg or tonne); fixtures and door/window sets may be by number or another specified unit. Thin partitions, shutters, frames and roof items have their own trade-specific rules: never infer the payment unit solely from the item name.

Many IS 1200 parts use dimensions to 0.01 m and computed areas and volumes to 0.01 m² and 0.01 m³ respectively, with trade-specific exceptions; for example concrete slab thickness may be measured to 0.005 m under the relevant part. Verify current part, specification and contract rounding rules. Record actual dimensions first; do not round individual intermediate operations excessively.
body.gu:
Measurement item અને લાગુ IS 1200 part પ્રમાણે છે: excavation, concrete અને મોટાભાગનું masonry સામાન્ય રીતે m³ માં; plaster, flooring, roofing, formwork અને painting સામાન્ય રીતે m² માં; pipes તથા કેટલાક skirting/mouldings m માં; structural steel અથવા reinforcement mass મુજબ kg/tonne માં; fixtures અને door/window sets number અથવા અન્ય નિર્ધારિત unit માં હોઈ શકે છે. Thin partitions, shutters, frames અને roof items માટે અલગ trade-specific rules છે; ફક્ત નામ પરથી payment unit ન માનો.

IS 1200 ના ઘણા parts માં dimensions 0.01 m અને computed areas/volumes 0.01 m²/0.01 m³ સુધી લેવાય છે, પરંતુ trade-specific exceptions છે; ઉદાહરણ તરીકે લાગુ concrete part માં slab thickness 0.005 m સુધી માપાઈ શકે. Current part, specification અને contract rounding rules તપાસો. પ્રથમ actual dimensions નોંધો; intermediate operations માં વધુ rounding ન કરો.

items.syllabus_item: 1.11 IS 1200 rules for openings and lintels

body.en:
Masonry: generally openings each up to 0.10 m² are not deducted under the applicable masonry measurement rules; larger openings are deducted according to the relevant part and contract. Distinguish opening area from wall volume. RCC lintels measured separately replace masonry only where the applicable measurement rule requires deduction; use actual drawing length including specified bearing and avoid counting opening/lintel overlap twice. Small bearing-end exceptions are item-specific and must be checked in the relevant part.

Plaster: for the usual same plaster on both faces, openings up to 0.5 m² each have no deduction and no separate reveal addition; for openings above 0.5 and up to 3 m², one-face deduction commonly applies without separate jamb, soffit and sill addition; above 3 m², deduct both faces and measure eligible reveals. Intermediate openings have additional rules when faces differ or reveal conditions vary. Apply the relevant IS 1200 part and contract: the simplified rule is not universal for every reveal detail.
body.gu:
Masonry: લાગુ masonry measurement rules હેઠળ સામાન્ય રીતે દરેક 0.10 m² સુધીના openings deduct થતા નથી; મોટા openings સંબંધિત part અને contract પ્રમાણે deduct થાય છે. Opening area અને wall volume અલગ છે. અલગ માપેલા RCC lintel માટે લાગુ rule મુજબ જ તે બદલતું masonry deduct કરો; drawing મુજબ specified bearing સહિત actual length લો અને opening/lintel overlap બે વાર deduct ન કરો. નાના bearing-end exceptions item-specific છે; સંબંધિત part તપાસો.

Plaster: સામાન્ય રીતે બંને faces પર સમાન plaster હોય ત્યારે દરેક 0.5 m² સુધીના opening માટે deduction કે અલગ reveal addition નથી; 0.5 કરતાં વધુ અને 3 m² સુધી સામાન્ય રીતે એક face ની deduction થાય છે અને jamb, soffit, sill અલગ ઉમેરાતાં નથી; 3 m² થી વધુ માટે બંને faces deduct કરી યોગ્ય reveals માપો. Intermediate openings માં faces અથવા reveal conditions જુદી હોય તો વધારાના rules લાગુ પડે છે. સંબંધિત IS 1200 part અને contract અનુસરો; આ simplified rule દરેક reveal detail માટે સાર્વત્રિક નથી.

body.en:
Given: A building has 120 m² covered plinth area. A comparable all-inclusive building rate is ₹22,000/m². Find approximate building cost before separately excluded site works.

Step 1. Use the comparable area rate.

Approximate cost = plinth area × rateApproximate cost = 120 × 22000

Final answer:

₹26,40,000; add only genuinely excluded items.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Building નું covered plinth area 120 m² છે. સમાન building માટે all-inclusive rate ₹22,000/m² છે. અલગથી બાકાત site works પહેલાં approximate building cost ગણો.

Step 1. Comparable area rate વાપરો.

Approximate cost = plinth area × rateApproximate cost = 120 × 22000

અંતિમ જવાબ:

₹26,40,000; ફક્ત ખરેખર બાકાત items ઉમેરો.

body.en:
Given: A 4.0 m long, 3.0 m high, 0.23 m thick wall has one 1.0 m × 2.0 m opening and an RCC lintel 1.30 m × 0.23 m × 0.15 m immediately above the opening. Assume full opening and lintel volumes are deductible and do not overlap. Find net brickwork.

Step 1. Calculate gross wall volume.

Gross = 4.0 × 3.0 × 0.23Gross = 2.760 m³

Step 2. Calculate opening and lintel separately.

Opening = 1.0 × 2.0 × 0.23Opening = 0.460 m³Lintel = 1.30 × 0.23 × 0.15Lintel = 0.04485 m³

Step 3. Subtract each volume once.

Net = 2.760 − 0.460 − 0.04485Net = 2.25515 m³

Final answer:

Net brickwork ≈ 2.26 m³ (rounded at the end).

આપેલ છે: 4.0 m લાંબી, 3.0 m ઊંચી અને 0.23 m જાડી wall માં 1.0 m × 2.0 m opening અને તેની ઉપર તરત 1.30 m × 0.23 m × 0.15 m RCC lintel છે. સંપૂર્ણ opening અને lintel deduction લાગુ છે અને overlap નથી એમ માનો. Net brickwork શોધો.

Step 1. Gross wall volume ગણો.

Gross = 4.0 × 3.0 × 0.23Gross = 2.760 m³

Step 2. Opening અને lintel અલગ ગણો.

Opening = 1.0 × 2.0 × 0.23Opening = 0.460 m³Lintel = 1.30 × 0.23 × 0.15Lintel = 0.04485 m³

Step 3. દરેક volume એક વાર બાદ કરો.

Net = 2.760 − 0.460 − 0.04485Net = 2.25515 m³

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Net brickwork ≈ 2.26 m³ (અંતે rounding).

title.gu: Numerical 1.3 — Plaster opening deduction ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: Both faces of a 4 m × 3 m wall have the same plaster. A window opening is 1.2 m × 1.2 m. Apply the simplified same-faces rule: deduct one face and do not add reveals. Find measured plaster.

Step 1. Find gross area of two faces.

Gross plaster = 2 × 4 × 3Gross plaster = 24 m²

Step 2. Find opening area.

Opening = 1.2 × 1.2Opening = 1.44 m²

Step 3. Deduct one face under the stated rule.

Measured plaster = 24 − 1.44

Final answer:

Measured plaster = 22.56 m².
body.gu:

Step 1. બે faces નો gross area ગણો.

Gross plaster = 2 × 4 × 3Gross plaster = 24 m²

Step 2. Opening area શોધો.

Opening = 1.2 × 1.2Opening = 1.44 m²

Step 3. આપેલ rule મુજબ એક face બાદ કરો.

Measured plaster = 24 − 1.44

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Measured plaster = 22.56 m².

name.gu: Approximate estimate અને measurement ના સૂત્રો

body.en:
Use a comparable current rate and state inclusions and exclusions.

Plinth-area estimate = plinth area × plinth-area rate
Cubical estimate = building volume × cubic rate
Service-unit estimate = number of service units × cost per unit
Gross volume = number × length × breadth × depth
Item amount = measured quantity × unit rate
